name: bq-tax-compliance
description: Analyse 2026 national tax procedure in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. Use for filing invitations, assessments, payment terms, records, objections, first-instance appeals, payment relief, allocation and collection interest. Separates return deadlines from assessment collection, taxpayer remedies from enforcement opposition, and statutory rules from older guidance. Includes primary legislation, current authority pages, conditional calendar and monetary examples, evidence controls and source discrepancies. This source-cited draft holds unresolved interest methods, relief interactions, late filings, special collection cases and actual form mapping. Load with the universal workflow base and relevant tax companions; professional review remains required.
